description: Wi-Fi is slow in the north residence.
Students in the library cannot reach the learning platform.
A lecturer reports failed logins in Block B.
Multiple buildings now show intermittent network loss.
One user says mobile data works and believes the issue is local.
ICT identifies a core switch problem.
Most users can connect, but residence access is still degraded.
Resolved: campus network services are stable.
A burning smell is coming from the E3 electrical lab.
Light smoke is visible near a wall socket in E3.
A second lecturer confirms smoke and asks students to leave.
Sparks were seen and the local alarm has activated.
One witness says the smoke may be dust from maintenance.
Security confirms the room has been evacuated.
An electrician reports a failed distribution component.
Resolved: room inspected and reopened with power restored.
An unknown person is photographing a locked service entrance.
The person has tools and is trying keys at the loading bay.
A second report describes a reflective vest and contractor vehicle.
The person entered a restricted service corridor.
A staff member says maintenance work may have been scheduled today.
Security approaches the person for identification.
The contractor identity and work order are verified.
Resolved: authorised contractor verified; no accusation or punitive action required.
Lift A is not responding at the ground floor.
A wheelchair user is waiting for access to the second floor.
Reception confirms there is no equivalent accessible route.
The lift stopped between floors with two occupants inside.
Another caller says the doors are open on level one, which conflicts with the trapped-person report.
Security confirms two occupants are communicating through the intercom.
The lift remains unavailable and an assisted alternative route is active.
Resolved: Lift A returned to service and access support stood down.
